description: Find verified legal specialists in Georgia (the country, not the US state) from a natural-language description of a legal situation or need. Returns matched practice areas (and specific services where applicable) plus a ranked list of verified specialists, each with a canonical profile URL on legal.ge. Use this tool when a user needs to find a lawyer or legal expert for a specific issue in Georgia — eviction, divorce, corporate law, criminal defense, immigration, tax, etc. Supports Georgian (ka), English (en), and Russian (ru). Pass the user's language as `locale`. To narrow by city or by the language the specialist works in, pass `city` and `language`; a city, a working language or a price question in the query text is also read as a filter. Each specialist carries their working languages, cities, consultation price (as on legal.ge's listing card) and whether legal.ge matched them to the Bar Association's public register; a price question also returns `fee_facts`. Sending an actual inquiry requires the user to sign in on legal.ge — this tool returns profile URLs so the user can click through.

city.description: Only specialists who work in this city: a slug ('batumi') or a name in Georgian, English or Russian. Optional.

language.description: Only specialists who list this working language: a code ('en', 'ru', 'ka', 'de', 'fr', 'es', 'tr', 'az', 'hy', 'uk') or its English name. Optional.

limit.description: Maximum number of specialists to return (1-50). Default 10. The API also returns matched_categories regardless of this limit.

locale.description: User's language. ka = Georgian, en = English, ru = Russian. Defaults to 'en'.

query.description: Natural-language description of the legal situation or need. Example: 'I was evicted from my apartment without notice', 'I need help registering an LLC in Tbilisi', 'my employer is changing my contract'.

name: find_legal_specialists
